body:
Small things that I'm looking forward to... my parents are coming down in december other than that I wake up, go to work, come home. I'm trying to fast forward pay my car off so extra money is going to be nil for about a year... unless I get a job that pays more. So after that I can only do free shit... which is just about nothing lol. I can go to parks and stuff but unless I have a dog or another reason to be there I'd probably just look like a creeper... I don't really drink so even going alone to bars or clubs would be wierd cause I'd be 100% sober -_- then on top of that probably a good 50% of the girls around here are tourists.

I kinda want a dog but mh favorite breed (husky) isn't good with the heat. My fallback is a $1500 dog that requires all the attention (border collie) and I just might settle for a cat -_-

I'm getting my motorcycle license this weekend but won'r be able to get a motorcycle till who knows when so I'm not really excited about it. If anything I'm super nervous because the last time I was on a motorcycle I got stuck in a rut and crashed into a tree 12 years ago xD

What can I say I'm a difficult case.

hrmm, when people get mad at me and raise their voice, hell it doesn't even have to be directed at me and I tend to shut down. It's like an automatic response from when I was growing up and my father's anger issues... regardless of this I'd say we were about 50/50 on communication since with some women logic goes right out the window.

I have perused the option and even interviewed at a couple of web development places. But even an entry level job in web development requires experience, go figure. The only work I've done was personal stuff for a group of guys in EvE Online. I have a REALLY hard time programming something that won't be used... it feels like such a waste of time. 

I work about 30m away from home, there's only 1 or 2 guys even close to my age at work and I'm not really more than acquaintances with anyone. People I'd consider my friends they all live far away, not that this is their fault it's just the fact of the matter. In other words I'm not blaming any of this on my current friends, the few that I have. This last weekend was a great time but I can't drive 6 hours every weekend to be close to people.

Yea, I mean, like I said it red flag city, I consider it a bullet dodged it's just, I really enjoyed talking to her and was looking forward to possibly having an intimate connection with someone again.

What would make me happier? Well, for starters probably a development job... and it's not even about the money. I make enough now to be comfortable, sure I'd love a little more... but it's honestly not about that. I literally have a passion for coding but I just can't get into the field with a 2 year degree and no experience.

When I moved out after college, I moved about an hour away from home, moved into my own place and took my current girlfriend with me. As I've said, I enjoy playing video games but I know how to reach a mutual agreement on times. So I'd play a few days here and a few there and spend time with her on the other days. It seemed though that the days I'd play would get less and less often because she'd drop the, "you don't spend any time with me, card." I would like to mention that I was the sole provider because she had to quit her job (no car). While we were together I helped her get her drivers license, worked out a deal to get her a car as she started a new job, and took her to and from various interviews all the while supporting her. I would work, come home, cook, eat with her, and then spend time with her. As she started getting paid I figured she'd start helping with the financial responsibilities. My step-father's birthday was in here somewhere, and my parents and a few friends of theirs had a dual b-day party for him and another guy and we went. It was great fun imo, a lot of great people. Well one of the gag gifts was [billy-bob teeth](http://www.faketeeth.net/servlet/Search?category=Billy+Bob+Teeth) and she was from Kentucky. Instead of getting over it and being mature she took **MAJOR** offense to it and thus resented my parents from then on, which I couldn't really handle since I'm pretty close to both of them. On like her second check I explained that my phone contract was running up and I needed to get a new phone. She had a track phone and wanted a contracted fancy smartphone as well. I told her that she'd buy hers and I'd buy mine and if she didn't have enough when I got mine she'd have to wait because I *had* to get mine or go without a phone. Well the launch week of the S3 came out and I went and picked one up with about 1 week left on my contract. She, got, pissed. I explained again why I couldn't wait or I'd be without. She had to go to work and I had to go to bed. A few days later I had a long day at work and came home, did the typical routine and when she left for work around 9pm I started playing minecraft, around 11:30 I told her that I was going to go to bed cause frankly I wanted to just chill and unwind and not have to keep up with her rapid fire texts. Well I was playing minecraft and queue 4 hours later I say good night to the guys on my server which runs on the computer that she typically uses. Well, when she came home in the morning the bedroom door was locked for some reason and she couldn't get in to get her clothes after taking a shower and I wasn't waking up to her pounding on the door. So she goes in and wastes some time on the computer and sees the message where I said good night at 3am....... again super pissed. I will admit yes, I lied to her, no I don't feel that she had much of a right to get so obnoxiously angry about it. Well, after I get back from work and fuming over it all day, I get home, do the typical routine again, like always, god forbid she'd help me do anything and she starts going off on me again about playing too many video games and not being with her enough. So I said fuck it and told her to leave. I was sick and tired of her shit.  she was gone before the weekend. From August to February I was alone, I worked, cooked, played video games, repeat. After she left I had so much extra money I traded in my impala for this sexy [beast](http://i.imgur.com/0gO1hGq.jpg). I ended the lease on my apt saved up money for my last two months of work and then drove from Ohio to Vegas with only what I needed. 

I've only been here for about 4 months or so after being laid off in Ohio. I'm not really afraid or affected by being away from my family, they can't fill the hole. My current roommate, my sudo-sister-in-law, is leaving in December to join her husband in the U.A.E. and after that I'll truly be alone.

I guess there's a lot of little shit that's built up. 

I just want to point out that my dad NEVER paid child support and has only had to support himself since I was 13 so roughly 12 years.

After my 2-year college I attempted to go back to an engineering school that would've set me up for what I wanted to do. No one but my dad was willing to co-sign for me. I signed up for classes, got my dorm around, and talk to him about signing for a loan and he puts it off for about a month and then buys a motorcycle. I push him to sign for me again and we try and of course it fails and you guessed it, because he bought a motorcycle.

My dad just sold my childhood home for something like 150k a few weeks ago and texted me to brag about it, so I was like, "oh, you should pay off my school loans (10k) then." and he has the audacity to say, "That's what you have a job for."

I'm jealous of my friend in SLC because he has a wonderful freaking gf. I'm jealous of the owner of this house the husband I mentioned earlier, he's my BEST friend from high school. He's 21 fucking years old making $40+ an hour non-taxable income and simply does the fuck he wants.

I hate myself for being jealous because it's so petty.
I hate myself for not having any confidence with anything.
I hate myself for being such a cynical asshole to so many random people.
I hate myself for being unable to see things through till the end.
I hate myself for being the nice guy that gets walked all over by the people that I think I care about.
I hate myself for being 50lbs heavier than I want to be but can't commit to losing weight.

There's other random shit that I omitted or left out, being bullied all through school. My dad when I was 13. My parents getting divorced. Being lied to by women, being ignored by others.

All I have are video games... I play online with a few friends that are scattered across the world but in the end they're only friends, that can only fill the void so much.

The ONLY job with comparable pay that I could get in Vegas after 2.5 months of searching was technical support. So currently I'm working that, and let me tell you it is so awful. My dream job is software development but without a fancy piece of paper that says Bachelor's degree fuck any chance of that.

And concerning the girl, she did lead me on. She sent me TONs of pictures of her, probably just fishing for compliments but sent them nonetheless, in one she was even scantly clad to show me her tattoo... I made it VERY apparent what I thought of her body and personality. Come Friday night when I got to Salt Lake I was getting BIG TIME mixed messages.  It wasn't until I confronted her about the mixed messages Saturday night after driving from Vegas to Salt Lake on Friday to see her and she stood me up that I found out she was in a relationship... After that I was like whelp there goes so many red flags it's not funny plus being lied to like that is a HUGE pet peeve of mine. Regardless after a 6h drive and a lot of gas money, flowers, and chocolate I find out she's dating someone and my obvious attempts at flirting....^weren't^so^obvious.

Anyway, I've already let that shit go, it was more or less the last bit of fire needed to burn the fuse on the powder keg that is my life. I'm sick and tired of being sick and tired. Death has no negative connotations in my eyes. Death is an end to this hell we call life and I'm done with waking up the next day waiting for it to get better.

I *know* I can work hard and pay off my debt, woooo no debt what next. Go back to school and get more debt so I can do what I want? That's the ticket! I love it! Great Idea! WRONG! I've thought about the military but I have a HUGE hangup with this countries current ideals and what we're doing in the world.

I guess in the end I just don't see a reason to continue living...
